description: Bring professional-quality baking tools to your home kitchen with the GoodCook Sweet Creations 3-Piece Mixing Bowl Set. This set of three kitchen bowls are great for a variety of cooking and baking tasks, from mixing and whisking to preparing ingredients. The non-slip base on each bowl provides stability while mixing, and the convenient nesting design allows for efficient storage on shelves and in cabinets when not in use. The high-impact BPA-free ABS plastic construction is made to last, and these mixing bowls are top rack dishwasher safe for easy care and clean up. The on-trend white, mint, and turquoise colors add a touch of style to any kitchen. The small bowl has a 1.5QT capacity, the medium bowl has a 3QT capacity, and the large bowl has a 5QT capacity so you always have the ideal size for any kitchen task. For over 30 years, GoodCook has created the tools that have made life in the kitchen easier and more enjoyable. As we’ve grown, we strived to stay on trend and continually incorporate more function and value into our kitchenware products. We take pride in the fact that GoodCook products are being used every day, and that our name is recognized as a helpful resource supplying products, recipes and inspiration for home cooks across America.
